cases.scenario: A synthetic greenhouse uplink record contains TLS 1.3 fields naming X25519MLKEM768 and TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256. The record is parsed only; it supplies no verified handshake result.

technical_expectations.expected: X25519MLKEM768 combines X25519 ECDH and final ML-KEM-768, using supported-group identifier 4588 (0x11EC).

technical_expectations.expected: Cipher-suite 4865 (0x1301) is TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 and specifies the AEAD and hash, not the key-exchange group.

technical_expectations.expected: Parsing hello fields does not supply the Finished verification needed for authenticated handshake assurance.
technical_expectations.rationale: The source requires verification of Finished contents; the assurance label must not be inferred from the group name.

unconfirmed: Both session records are invented; no real connection or endpoint was contacted.
